name: Stellar Wanderer DX
detailed_description:
You are a freelancer who just survived an assassination attempt on your client and yourself. Discover the universe as you make new friends and new enemies, unravel interstellar plots, and fight in intense space battles! Follow the story, or explore the open galaxy at your own pace. As a pilot, you can travel star systems, fight hostiles, mine and trade resources, upgrade and customize your ship. The universe is your oyster! Prove your skills - be a fearless bounty hunter, a helpful ally, a thriving merchant, a respected racing champion, or even become the most dangerous outlaw in the galaxy. Adventure awaits among the stars!

Engage in dangerous dogfights with rival factions, enemy armadas, ruthless pirates, and enigmatic aliens! Battle in third person, first person, and even cockpit view! Your victory will be the measure of your skills, tactics, and weapons arsenal. The combat offers a thrilling experience for every aspiring space warrior, whether you choose precision or raw firepower. 

 

Be a Fighter, Trader, Tank, or Engineer, each with its special ability and bonuses. Choose from over a dozen unique ships and customize each one with over 100 different weapons or devices. Upgrade your weapons, shields, or engine to become the most dangerous fighter in the galaxy. Choose from additional equipment such as tractor beams, hidden compartments, or passenger cabins to go the merchant route.

Trade, mine, or smuggle your way to riches as you travel between systems, each with its own economy, prices, and needs. Discover trade routes, mining spots, and even contraband! But be careful, the police don't appreciate illegal goods!

Set sail on your ship and navigate through a variety of gorgeous space sets, each with several points of interest. Roam between safe, high-security systems, trade in the independent border worlds, or choose the danger of the pirate systems. Discover caches hidden in the deepest corners of the galaxy.

Immerse yourself in a captivating story with 10 hours of gameplay and full voice acting (voices available in English only). Meet charismatic characters, uncover ancient secrets, and engage in the most epic space battles. The fate of mankind and the universe lies in your hands!

Explore a beautiful universe filled with gorgeous retro-style visuals and unique atmospheric design. From the vastness of space to the bustling spaceports, from the abandoned junkyards to the intricate industrial installations, every detail is meticulously crafted to create a truly immersive experience.

Take on a variety of side missions in every space station. Hunt for bounties, escort friends through hostile territory, mine or deliver goods, and more! You can even race other pilots!

Stellar Wanderer DX features numerous improvements to its space systems, visuals, and gameplay, offering a new deluxe experience. Space systems have been rebuilt from scratch and expanded with new points of interest. Environments, ships, cockpits, and more have been reworked and improved with a higher level of detail. Various gameplay mechanics, controls, and settings have been tweaked to provide a better experience.

short_description: Fight, trade, mine, and explore the galaxy in this old-school space combat simulator. You are a freelance pilot who survived an assassination attempt. Travel the open world, chase bounties, get new ships, upgrade your gear, and, why not, maybe even save humankind!
supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 32 or 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 8 series, Radeon HD 2000 series or Intel HD 4000 series
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
